summary: Iter 152 Audit Trail + GeoIP — verified end-to-end. Ran 10/10 iter152 backend tests (geoip + audit endpoints) and 36/36 regression tests (iter145/146/147/148/151) — all PASS. UI verified at desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (414x900) after logging in as Owner_homeme with 2FA. Audit Log page renders Top Countries widget (United States 76), Backfill GeoIP button, CSV export, action/success filters, country flag badges on rows. Mobile header has no horizontal overflow at 414px and all aux components are correctly hidden.

minor.issue: iter147 mandatory_2fa e2e test rotates Owner_homeme's two_factor_secret/two_factor_enabled and does NOT restore them in teardown — breaks subsequent automated tests / UI flows that rely on the seeded TOTP secret JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXPJBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP. Recommend either (a) a session-scoped teardown that re-seeds the secret, or (b) using a dedicated throwaway user in iter147.

issues: Hamburger / notifications-bell / theme-toggle icons are visually present on mobile but do not have the data-testid='hamburger-button', 'notifications-bell', 'theme-toggle' attributes that the review_request expected. Existing testids are sidebar-* on the open sidebar; the closed-state top-bar icons in Layout.js have no testids. Not a functional bug, just a testability gap.

action_items: (minor) Add data-testid attributes for the mobile top-bar trigger icons in /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.js (hamburger / notifications / theme toggle) so future automated tests can target them by name.

(minor) Make iter147 mandatory_2fa test self-cleaning so it doesn't leave Owner_homeme's two_factor_secret empty (it currently clears the seed and breaks parallel/follow-up tests). Workaround: re-seed via mongodb update after running iter147.

Audit log entries are written for company.create/update/delete with target_id matching new company id — verified via test_company_lifecycle_audit_trail.
Summary endpoint returns new top_countries aggregation correctly; country filter on list endpoint returns only matching geo.country_code rows.
Backfill-geo endpoint returns {processed, enriched} with enriched ≤ processed sanity invariant holding.

Mobile header overflow fix is effective — at 414px, body has zero horizontal overflow and all flagged aux components (user-info-card, compound-switcher, subscription-badge, session-switcher, plan-limit-badge, quick-account-switcher, language-switcher) are correctly hidden / not in DOM.

context_for_next_testing_agent: If you see 401 'الرمز غير صحيح' on /api/2fa/verify-login despite correct TOTP, the iter147 mandatory_2fa test has wiped Owner_homeme's two_factor_secret. Re-seed with: db.users.update_one({'username':'Owner_homeme'}, {'$set':{'two_factor_secret':'JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXPJBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP','two_factor_enabled':True}}). Field names are two_factor_secret + two_factor_enabled (NOT totp_secret / totp_enabled).
rca of the issue: Backend uses fields user['two_factor_secret'] and user.get('two_factor_enabled') in routes/two_factor.py verify-login (line 213, 217). The iter147 enrolment e2e test follows the real enrolment flow, which overwrites these fields with a fresh randomly-generated secret, and the test does not restore the seeded JBSWY... secret in teardown. So once iter147 runs in a regression sweep, Owner_homeme can no longer authenticate via the seeded TOTP until manually re-seeded.
